context.environment: Windows k6 2.2.0 -> IDEA Java 21 single instance -> Docker MySQL 8.4 / Redis 7.4 / RabbitMQ 4.1
context.load: constant arrival rate, 5 seconds, 512 preallocated VUs, 5000 capacity per tier, unique authenticated users and idempotency keys, fresh event/session/tier per run, no payment
context.settings: expiry, payment recovery, notification publisher disabled equally in all stages; Hikari max 32; before Tomcat 300 and no admission; scoped Tomcat 300 and no admission; final Tomcat 128/admission 48; tuned same build with admission 96; stable same final 48 after warmup
context.limitations: short local measurements with host variability; CPU sampled by Docker stats only in stable runs; transaction/lock counters are instance-wide deltas, not per-request traces; invalid expired-token runs are excluded
